description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of BCryptHelper in the org.eclipse.hono.auth package.

classes.name: BCryptHelperTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that includes tests for handling invalid hashes, unsupported BCrypt versions, and successful extraction of iteration counts from valid BCrypt hashes.

methods.name: testGetIterationsFailsForInvalidHash
methods.description: Test expecting an IllegalArgumentException when an invalid hash string is provided to getIterations.

methods.name: testGetIterationsFailsForUnsupportedVersion
methods.description: Test expecting an IllegalArgumentException when a hash with an unsupported BCrypt version is processed.

methods.name: testGetIterationsSucceedsForValidHash
methods.description: Test verifying that getIterations correctly extracts the iteration count from a valid BCrypt hash.
